title: East Potomac Park trees cut as golf rebuild starts

views.label: Now
views.text: Work started in September 2026. NPS cut more than 60 trees along the park roads. Officials call that maintenance.

views.label: Place
views.text: East Potomac Park is a filled river park. The Hains Point loop and cherry plantings sit on this outline.

views.label: Change
views.text: A championship golf rebuild is in motion. Course plans could take trail land and cherry groves.

views.label: Outcome
views.text: Public access to the loop is not settled. Walk the edge. Tap a stop to read one part of the story.
